title: Juicy Australian Corn Grill
description: A buttery and juicy vegetarian dish featuring fine yellow cornmeal, char-grill flavors, and a sick-day twist, this Australian-inspired corn grill is perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, around 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the unsalted butter, lemon juice, and water to the bowl, stirring until the mixture forms a thick batter.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto a piece of aluminum foil or a grill mat, shaping into small patties.
Place the patties onto the preheated grill, cooking for 4-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and slightly charred.
Repeat the cooking process for the remaining batter, adjusting the heat as needed to prevent burning.
Once cooked, remove the corn patties from the grill and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Juicy Australian Corn Grill hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs or a dollop of sour cream if desired.
